articles.title: Trying to understand student deaths and protests in India
articles.highlight: 印度反政府抗议部分由学生自杀事件引发，这些学生被要求重考医学考试后自杀。
articles.summary: 这篇文章来自NPR World，解释了印度反政府抗议活动的导火索之一：多名学生在被命令重考医学考试后自杀身亡。文章通过这一事件揭示了教育政策与青年困境之间的关联，帮助读者理解抗议背后的深层社会压力。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：政策指令若忽视学生的心理压力和现实困境，可能引发难以预料的严重后果。新闻报道应关注事件背后的制度性原因，而非仅停留在表面冲突。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Anti-government protests in India were partly triggered by students who died by suicide after they were ordered to retest for a medical exam.

en.summary: This article reports that GPT 5.6 achieved a 13x reduction in intelligence cost in four months through recursive self-optimization and knowledge distillation, leading to price cuts of 20-80%. The takeaway is that distillation is becoming a key lever for AI cost reduction.
